activation.applicability: A Planning closeout claim has unresolved evidence, accepted progress or external review custody.
activation.outcome: Truthful current Planning status with proof and independent acceptance kept separate.

activation.applicability: New work needs useful decomposition or durable intent, constraints and dependencies beyond sufficient existing records; changed scope, accepted progress, interruption or handoff also has continuity value.
activation.outcome: Sufficient existing task meaning is reused, or native Planning custody is created/selected and verified before needed meaning is lost; direct work needs no duplicate record.

activation.applicability: A concrete pre-binding local/delegate choice needs judgment, or current binding Assignment/dispatch/handoff needs exact continuation. Unrelated ordinary local work does not need this method.
activation.outcome: A quiet local or unknown/defer choice, current Assignment assessment for a delegate proposal, or exact binding continuation with truthful owner gaps.

activation.applicability: Review findings or a worker return require current accepted continuation rather than assumed progress.
activation.outcome: Supported findings have an authorised next step; approval remains separate.

skills.summary: Planning host-discovery entry for shared Setup package refresh; preserve plans and custody.
Check whether delivered work satisfies the requested outcome and identify what must remain open.
Report selected work, remaining steps and restrictions from current Planning detail.
Relate a task to an existing plan, divide substantial work, and save what a later session needs.
Decide whether a bounded task benefits from delegation, or follow an existing assignment and its return requirements.
Decide which current review findings need action and preserve any justified unfinished work.
